CONTROLS.NAME: grid_1
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When ON, the usually larger, static, colored grid of circles will be visible, when OFF, the circles won't appear.

CONTROLS.NAME: pulser
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When ON, pulses of rings will propagate through the main grid's circles. When OFF, no rings will appear.

CONTROLS.NAME: resolution
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Controls the number and size of the circles on the main grid. Also affects the size of the pulser and mask. Higher is more, smaller pieces.

CONTROLS.NAME: grid_2
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When ON, a grid of smaller dots that react to an underlying shape (or Media) will be visible. Turn OFF for a simpler scene featuring only the main grid.

CONTROLS.NAME: resolution_2
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: grid 2 MUST BE ON. Controls the number and size of the active grid's circles.

CONTROLS.NAME: intensity
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: grid 2 MUST BE ON. Controls the size and intensity of the action in the active grid's motion.

CONTROLS.NAME: black_or_white
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: grid 2 MUST BE ON. Controls the color of the active grid's circles.

CONTROLS.NAME: invert
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Make every color it's opposite, instead. Results in a nice blue color scheme when ON. Use alongside black or white to control color.

CONTROLS.NAME: mask
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Add some regular black shapes to the scene. The size and number are controlled by 'resolution'. The shape type is controlled by 'Transition'.

CONTROLS.NAME: rotating
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn ON to start the whole scene rotating, or OFF to keep it rectilinear.
